items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-01
items.q: I got nervous every time I walked by the card room to go to the John after that.

ctx.x: New Orleans Item was doing an expose on gambling, and there was a poker game going on in the back room of the place. And one of the habitués spotted my camera in flash and had this great plan that would give everybody a laugh where I would go in and take a flash picture or perhaps just pretend to take a flash picture of the card game, and I managed in a fairly friendly manner to decline, but I got nervous every time I walked by the card room to go to the John after that.
Facing the band, the John was to the left.
